video_title: Will the Clippers trade KAWHI LEONARD⁉️ Shams Charania details | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo's decision to leave Milwaukee
quotes.excerpt: Giannis Antetokounmpo informed the Bucks about a calendar year ago that he was ready for a trade.
quotes.quote: John Horst, the general manager, and his front office in Milwaukee, Jimmy Haslam, Wes Edens, the two co-owners, they all found a consensus on direction, on finality, on where they were moving with this organization. Giannis Antetokounmpo informed the Bucks about a calendar year ago that he was ready for a trade. He wanted out of Milwaukee and that he was not going to sign another contract extension in Milwaukee. The Bucks did everything they could to try to win. They even kept this going even longer than Giannis or anyone there potentially wanted it to, to see can we make it work. They stretched and waived Damian Lillard in a historic move to try to do that.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Miami Heat salary cap constraints after acquiring Giannis
quotes.excerpt: They are now hard-capped at the first apron. So they basically have $18 million to go spend.
quotes.quote: It is the price of doing business when you can acquire a top-five player in Giannis. Certainly when you give up a starter in Tyler Herro and now three bench players, there is work to do. When you look at Miami, a little bit of math here real quick, they are now hard-capped at the first apron. So they basically have $18 million to go spend between five players here. They are likely going to lose Norman Powell as a result of this trade. Now, there are ways to get a little more flexibility. A player like Anthony Simons, for example, he has got a player option. They could potentially lower that number, attach a second year to that, gives them a little bit more flexibility here. But as we have seen in the past, this Miami Heat front office has gone out and found Max Strus and Gabe Vincent, these under-the-radar players here. I think keep an eye on one name, Anthony Simons. They need perimeter shooting for this Heat team. He is a free agent out there. If he is willing to basically go for the veteran minimum and play out a year and maybe restore his value for next year, he would fit in perfectly with this team.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Roster needs for the Miami Heat after trading for Giannis
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to assume they get Wiggins back. That's a priority in your mind, right?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I like it a lot when you think of Giannis by himself. You think of Giannis coming over there, you think of him joining Bam Adebayo. I'm going to assume they get Wiggins back. I'm just going to assume they they get Wiggins back.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: That's a priority in your mind, right?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Yeah. When you start doing that, then you start filling in your shooters. I can see it happening. I really do like Anthony Simons because that's the second coming of Damian Lillard if I ever saw it. Obviously, they spent a lot of time together. But he is one of those guys that brings perimeter shooting but also takes care of the basketball. It can help make decisions. I just need playmakers around him that can shoot because anytime you have Giannis Antetokounmpo and he is going downhill all the time, you look at other teams, their job is to load up and keep him out of the middle of the floor.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's future with the Clippers
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi Leonard has one year left on his deal. The Clippers have been in this position before.
quotes.quote: There are multiple teams monitoring Kawhi Leonard right now here over the next few weeks. Kawhi Leonard has one year left on his deal. The Clippers have been in this position before with Kawhi Leonard. When you go into the final year of your deal, you want to know as a veteran player, you are either going to get an extension or not, and Kawhi Leonard is at that point in his career. So whatever happens tonight, I don't think the draft is necessarily dependent on Kawhi Leonard's future, but I think in the coming days and weeks, we will start to learn a little bit more about the Clippers, Kawhi Leonard, and a potential outside team as well.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics discussing potential Jaylen Brown trade
quotes.excerpt: The Boston Celtics have started to listen, engage and discuss trades around Jaylen Brown.
quotes.quote: I am told the hard conversations between these two sides have started. This has been a long relationship between Jaylen Brown and the Celtics. It has been mostly fruitful when you think about the success that these two sides have had. But I am told here, as we are hours away from the NBA draft, the Boston Celtics have started to listen, engage and discuss trades around Jaylen Brown. Sources tell me the Celtics are speaking to teams right now about Jaylen Brown. In 2022, the Celtics offered Jaylen Brown for Kevin Durant. Last summer, the Celtics did listen to trade offers for Jaylen Brown as they were trying to figure out how to shed salary under the aprons. They moved Chris Paul for things and Jrue Holiday to keep Jaylen Brown, and then here they offer Jaylen Brown for Giannis. The difference though here is Jaylen Brown is coming off a Finals MVP campaign. He is coming off a lot of success as an MVP finalist. So this is something everyone around the league does believe could reach an inflection point sooner than later.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The end of the Jaylen Brown and Celtics relationship
quotes.excerpt: This relationship is dead bird tall grass. And like the legend Usher say, papers. Sending in papers.
quotes.quote: This relationship is dead bird tall grass. And like the legend Usher say, papers. Sending in papers. The voice papers. This relationship has run its course. There is no coming back to this from this. If you are Jaylen Brown, why would you want to be back in Boston? Like, you just had the cook. No, no, no, no. Ray Allen won too, and he took less money and went to Miami. This is a different thing when you feel disrespected. And again, we are talking about a guy that finished top five in the MVP conversation. We are talking about a guy that is a Finals MVP. He has accolades that Kevin Garnett don't have in a Celtic uniform.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Boston's strategic approach to trading Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: I don't think there is for one player. I think it would be for multiple players.
quotes.quote: I don't think there is for one player. I think it would be for multiple players. For two or three players. I will say this, Boston knew that this could could have, you know, not happened here. So it wasn't like they woke up and said, uh-oh, we didn't make the trade, now what happens. They were well prepared. This deal got to the five-yard line. Milwaukee scored the touchdown, Boston left on the five-yard line. A Brown trade would likely have to be for two or three players.
